content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) defines prediabetes using the following criteria: 1. Hemoglobin A1C levels should fall between 5.7% and 6.4%, which corresponds to 39–47 mmol/mol. 2. Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) levels should range from 100 mg/dL (5.6 mmol/L) to 125 mg/dL (6.9 mmol/L). 3.8 mmol/L) and 199 mg/dL (11.0 mmol/L).
